subject.title: Gateway: carry side-chat display question in chat.side_result for non-initiating clients

question: Should this protected maintainer issue be promoted for the focused additive gateway/UI contract fix?
rationale: The technical boundary is clear, but the issue has the protected `maintainer` label, which requires explicit maintainer handling before implementation routing.

options.title: Promote focused fix
options.body: Approve a narrow change that carries the display question through the send request and all side-result producers and consumers with cross-client tests.

options.title: Defer the limitation
options.body: Keep the issue open as a known multi-client limitation until the side-chat event contract is revisited with broader gateway work.

recommendation.title: Promote focused fix
